final: WITH ch AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS b, AVG(f.feerate) AS a FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase), bm AS (SELECT AVG(f.feerate) AS m FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault) SELECT AVG(a) AS mean_avg_fee_rate, AVG(a - (SELECT m FROM bm)) AS mean_excess FROM ch WHERE a > (SELECT m FROM bm)
